title: Rollup
description: Module bundler optimized for libraries and ES modules.

data.text: Rollup is a module bundler for JavaScript that compiles small pieces of code into something larger and more complex, such as a library or application.
Rollup excels at producing efficient, tree-shakable bundles. It is the bundler behind many popular libraries including React, Vue, and D3.

data.caption: rollup.config.js

items.question: When should I use Rollup?
items.answer: For libraries and packages where bundle size and tree-shaking matter most.

items.question: Rollup vs Webpack?
items.answer: Rollup is simpler and produces smaller bundles. Webpack handles more complex application scenarios.

items.text: Tree shaking is a first-class feature.
